data.credibility: Management has not provided explicit prior guidance items in the ledger, leaving historical delivery unquantifiable from the provided material.
bull: Revenue compounded at 50.6% annually over five years, reaching ₹22,001 cr in TTM.
EBITDA margin widened significantly from 4.4% in FY21 to 18.7% in FY26.
Strong operating cash flow conversion at 123% of reported profit over the last 5 years.
bear: Growth is slowing down, registering 34.5% a year over three years against 50.6% over five.
Working-capital days stretched from -14 to -2 over the past 5 years.
High valuation reflected by a P/E ratio of 90.6.
